## Purpose and Entry Points
Documenso is a self-hostable electronic-signature platform: teams create documents/templates or multi-document envelopes, assign recipients and fields, distribute signing links, capture signatures, then produce signed PDFs, certificates, audit logs, notifications, and webhooks. The primary application is the React Router v7 server-rendered app at `apps/remix/app/entry.server.tsx`, with route registration in `apps/remix/app/routes.ts` and HTTP/server composition in `apps/remix/server/main.js`.

## Application Surfaces
The Remix app separates major trust boundaries by route namespace:
- Authenticated author/admin/team workflows: `apps/remix/app/routes/_authenticated+/`
- Public token-based recipient viewing/signing: `apps/remix/app/routes/_recipient+/sign.$token+/_index.tsx`
- Embedded signing and authoring integrations: `apps/remix/app/routes/embed+/v1+/` and `apps/remix/app/routes/embed+/v2+/`
- Operational callbacks and service endpoints, including Stripe and webhook triggers: `apps/remix/app/routes/api+/stripe.webhook.ts` and `apps/remix/app/routes/api+/webhook.trigger.ts`.

The docs site (`apps/docs/src/app/`) and community/growth API (`apps/openpage-api/app/`) are separate Next-based applications, not the signing runtime.

## Envelope and Signing Lifecycle
The current core aggregate is the envelope: it contains one or more PDF items, shared recipients, fields, settings, and attachments. The editor UI is centered on `apps/remix/app/components/general/envelope-editor/envelope-editor.tsx`; its server operations are exposed via `packages/trpc/server/envelope-router/router.ts` and domain services under `packages/lib/server-only/envelope/`.

A typical flow is create/edit envelope → upload/replace items → assign recipients and positioned fields → distribute → recipients access tokenized signing routes → sign fields → complete/seal. Mutable-state enforcement, recipient sequencing, and signature-level compatibility reside at boundaries such as `packages/lib/server-only/envelope/assert-envelope-mutable.ts`, `packages/lib/server-only/recipient/get-is-recipient-turn.ts`, and `packages/lib/server-only/signature-level/resolve-signing-order.ts`.

## APIs, Authorization, and Persistence
tRPC is the principal internal application API, composed from `packages/trpc/server/router.ts` and mounted into the Remix/Hono server through `apps/remix/server/trpc/hono-trpc-remix.ts`. A versioned external API is separately defined and implemented in `packages/api/v1/contract.ts` and `packages/api/v1/implementation.ts`. Authentication supports email/password, OAuth/OIDC, passkeys, sessions, and two-factor routes through `packages/auth/server/routes/`.

Prisma provides the persistence boundary and database schema at `packages/prisma/schema.prisma`; PostgreSQL is required. Domain services in `packages/lib/server-only/` encapsulate reads, mutations, authorization checks, quota/rate limits, and avoid putting business rules directly in UI routes.

## Documents, PDFs, and Storage
PDF viewing/rendering is client-facing in `apps/remix/app/components/general/pdf-viewer/pdf-viewer.tsx`. Server-side PDF operations—including field insertion, form flattening, partial signed PDFs, certificates, and audit artifacts—are concentrated in `packages/lib/server-only/pdf/` and `packages/lib/server-only/htmltopdf/`. Cryptographic signing is abstracted through `packages/signing/index.ts`, with local and Google Cloud transports.

Binary files are behind a storage-provider abstraction supporting S3 and Azure Blob implementations: `packages/lib/universal/upload/providers/s3-provider.ts` and `packages/lib/universal/upload/providers/azure-blob-provider.ts`. Document conversion can call Gotenberg via `packages/lib/server-only/document-conversion/gotenberg.ts`.

## Async Integrations and Enterprise Boundaries
Long-running work is dispatched through a pluggable jobs layer—local, BullMQ, or Inngest—at `packages/lib/jobs/client/`, with durable task definitions in `packages/lib/jobs/definitions/`. Jobs send emails, execute outbound webhooks, expire recipients, schedule reminders, and seal completed documents; sealing is defined at `packages/lib/jobs/definitions/internal/seal-document.ts`.

Email rendering/transports live in `packages/email/`; billing uses Stripe through `packages/ee/server-only/stripe/` and its webhook handler. Enterprise-only capabilities are isolated in `packages/ee/`, notably organization email domains, licensing/limits, Stripe workflows, and CSC qualified-signature integration under `packages/ee/server-only/signing/csc/`. Optional AI-assisted field/recipient detection is routed from `apps/remix/server/api/ai/` into `packages/lib/server-only/ai/`.
